goal: Ensure nodes can authenticate to the Tor control port when -torpassword contains backslashes
Prevents onion service creation from failing due to unescaped characters in the control password
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Approach approval after verifying spec compliance and reproducing the test failure on master (winterrdog)
Requested testing against an installed Tor instance and coordinating coverage with #35292 (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes authentication failure when -torpassword contains backslashes
Impact is limited to nodes configuring Tor control port authentication with backslash characters
